# NEW 2026-11-18 campaign enemy reactions. Generated by gen_heg_reactions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope: may be pulled into a campaign war against Byzantium. Location and pop countries (hordes count,
# r5); never building, army or navy countries.
oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = {
    OR = { country_type = location country_type = pop }
    is_rebel_country = no
    is_subject = no
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes }
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
    NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = c:BYZ } }
}
# Country scope: may join a campaign war on Byzantium's side.
oe_hcr_can_join_ours = {
    OR = { country_type = location country_type = pop }
    is_rebel_country = no
    is_subject = no
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
}
# Country scope: borders Byzantium or its bloc, or a country the running campaign is aimed at. Keeps the
# crusade and jihad joiners near the front (r5: Delhi joined the Egypt war).
oe_hcr_near_front = {
    any_neighbor_country = {
        OR = {
            tag = BYZ
            oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes
            has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_africa_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_france_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_britain_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_persia_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_target
            has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_target
        }
    }
}
# Country scope: near the front, or one country removed from it. Crusaders only: with direct borders alone the
# crusade drew in a small neighbour (r6: Argos); one step further reaches the Catholic powers of the region.
oe_hcr_near_front_2 = {
    OR = {
        oe_hcr_near_front = yes
        any_neighbor_country = { oe_hcr_near_front = yes }
    }
}
oe_hcr_crusader_ok = { religion = religion:catholic NOT = { tag = PAP } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes oe_hcr_near_front_2 = yes }
oe_hcr_muslim_ok = { religion.group = religion_group:muslim oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes oe_hcr_near_front = yes }
# BYZ scope.
oe_hcr_crusade_possible = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_crusade_cd }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_pope_friend }
    exists = c:PAP
    any_country = { oe_hcr_crusader_ok = yes }
}
oe_hcr_jihad_possible = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_jihad_cd }
    any_country = { OR = { oe_hcr_muslim_ok = yes AND = { tag = MAM religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
}
oe_hcr_holy_city_held = {
    OR = {
        location:mecca = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
        location:medina = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
        location:jerusalem = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope: the running campaign's pressure is 60 or more.
oe_hcr_pressure_high = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_pressure var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure >= 60 }
